question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.**

Saturn is the sixth planet from the sun and it is the second large in our solar system.
solution:
The erroneous segment is " **it is the second large**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, we need to use the superlative form of the adjective</strong&
